summary: Reviewed and tested the batch of 5 new feature sets: (1) Programs & Initiatives admin CRUD + reorder + categories + detail page + public filtering, (2) Admin bootstrap owner-email allowlist + CSV formula injection safety, (3) Site URL banner (missing->saved->gone), (4) Single-use donor_manage_tokens (receipt kind) via /api/donor/portal, (5) Cancellation thank-you page with prefilled note, undeliverable-email 424 revert, invalid-token 404, empty-subject 400. Added /app/backend/tests/test_programs_cancel.py (16 tests, 16/16 PASS). UI verified via Playwright on preview URL: /initiatives shows 6 program cards + 4 category filter buttons + 'All', Learn More -> /initiatives/<slug> program-detail with program-title/body/goals/impact/cta, unknown slug -> program-not-found, Admin -> Programs tab shows all 6 seeded admin-program-row with reorder/edit/toggle/delete controls, New Program form validates javascript: link via error toast and saves with valid link, Site URL banner flow (missing->click use-site-url-btn->site-url-banner-saved->reload hides banner), /cancel-thanks?token=QA renders cancel-thanks-page + cancel-thanks-summary + prefilled subject/message, send attempt to @example.com yields 424 cancel-thanks-error 'Note not sent: Email provider rejected the message.' and server reverts thanked=false (verified in DB), invalid token -> 'This link is invalid.' error. Regression smoke pages (/events, /transparency, /contact) load without errors. Cleanup complete.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3153 lines (prev 2853) - the file-size guideline (<700 lines) is heavily violated. Programs section (~140 lines), cancellation section (~130 lines), and donor manage-token section should be split into dedicated modules (programs.py, cancellations.py, donor_portal.py).

_handle_cancellation stores an idempotency guard via existence check on sub_id, but the cancellation token is only generated once; if a cancellation is re-sent via webhook before the staff-alert email delivery completes, the token exists but staff never received it. Consider decoupling token creation (always upsert) from staff-alert send with retry.

/api/programs/{slug} input length cap is slug[:100] but response is unmemoized and re-reads Mongo on each hit. Consider a simple in-process TTL cache (programs are rarely edited) to reduce DB load on /initiatives/<slug> pages.

_clean_program's image_url validator allows only /api/media/file/ or https://, but public cards also reference images.unsplash.com / images.pexels.com - these are allowed via https:// but there is no allowlist (admins could enter arbitrary https hosts). Low risk, but consider a whitelist for consistency.

The ADMIN_OWNER_EMAILS env var is only honored at startup/import time (constant at module load). If the owner-email list is changed in .env, the backend must be restarted - no runtime refresh. Document this ops requirement or move to a settings doc.

Site URL banner uses window.location.origin as the suggested value, but this is a preview URL in staging - admins must remember to re-save on production. Consider showing current effective PUBLIC_APP_URL alongside the banner.

Cancellation thank-you page: on 424 send failure, server reverts thanked=false (correct), but client state remains with 'sent' not toggled - user can retry safely, which is correct. However the error message leaks the provider rejection reason ('Email provider rejected the message.') - acceptable for staff-only link but worth reviewing.

donor_manage_tokens single-use is enforced via atomic update_one({used:false},{used:true}) in donor_portal (good), but there is no TTL index on expires_at - expired tokens accumulate forever. Add TTL index.
AdminPrograms.jsx 'Toast after invalid link' flow does NOT clear the form or restore cursor focus - minor UX miss. The toast dismisses, user has to click the field again.

Initiatives.jsx CtaLink only treats 'https://' as external; relative paths like /donate work, but 'http://...' or 'mailto:' would be routed as internal Link and 404. Backend already blocks these, so defense-in-depth is fine.

rca of the issue: No issues found. All 16 backend tests + 10 UI flow checks pass. One minor initial run failure due to missing CSRF header (X-Requested-With) in test fixture — fixed in test file. The 424 status for undeliverable cancellation email is intentional per main agent (Cloudflare rewrites 502 bodies).
